question: Does the sole zero-row-selected positive-overkill Facet-salvage representation preserve current-main at omitted and explicit off, preserve exact lethal, Ash and every mechanistic negative control at on, and isolate its producer, mediator, consumer, fixed one-Ember payoff and expiry under direct A/B/AB controls?
hypothesis: A Dusk authored Attack with canonical positive overkill can mark only its otherwise-lost base intrinsic Facet entitlement. The originating card's existing deferred settlement can aggregate one or more marks to one fixed Ember request after unchanged living-target settlement, then clear, while numeric overkill remains attribution telemetry rather than a scalar level.
claimBoundary: Source, interface, direct A/B/AB, call-cardinality, exact-null and intended-mediator identity only. No support, magnitude effect, capacity, causal endpoint, policy sensitivity, balance, product, acceptance or P9 claim.

terminalHitExcess.enabled: For a Dusk authored Attack only, mark each canonical killing blow with positive post-status/post-block overkill and its otherwise-lost base intrinsic Facet entitlement; at the same card's deferred settlement request one Ember at most once if combat continues, then clear.
terminalHitExcess.forbiddenLevels: Numeric overkill magnitude, threshold, bin, card, target, hit count and target count are observations only and cannot scale or select the payoff.

producerControl.role: Research-only mechanical A control; creates only the per-card positive-overkill intrinsic mark and expiry telemetry.

consumerControl.role: Research-only mechanical B control; without an A mark it must be exact null.

design.type: One binary-factor direct identity preflight with internal A/B/AB controls; not a factorial or endpoint experiment.
design.order: Within the candidate process, all omitted rows execute first before any configuration, then explicit off, AB, and the sole A-only/B-only component anchor.

anchors.null: Current-main, omitted and explicit off are canonically identical for all fourteen paired contexts after removing only probe labels.
anchors.positive: Only positive-overkill Dusk authored Attack rows emit the complete chain and change only the realised Ember delta plus research telemetry.
anchors.negative: Non-lethal, exact lethal, Ash, direct damage outside PLAY, poison and finale handoff are exact null at AB.
anchors.component: A-only creates and expires only the mediator; B-only is exact null; AB preserves A's producer/mediator and adds only the fixed consumer/payoff.

estimands.baselineIdentity: Zero current-main versus omitted and current-main versus explicit-off mismatches across fourteen paired identities.
estimands.negativeControls: Zero research events and zero canonical mismatches for every AB negative context, including exact lethal.
estimands.producerIdentity: A-only emits one positive-overkill producer, one intrinsic mediator-set and one consumer-disabled expiry, with no Ember or other state/path change.
estimands.consumerIdentity: B-only is exact null without a mark.
estimands.abChain: Eligible rows emit exact ordered producer/mediator pairs, at most one consumer, one requested-one payoff if combat continues and one expiry; two marks still request one.
estimands.payoffIsolation: After removing research events and the sole realised precision Ember event, and subtracting its realised delta, queue, state, enemies, run statistics, pending state, action result and RNG equal explicit off.
estimands.notEstimated: Positive-overkill frequency, magnitude response, natural capacity, policy choice, outcome, balance, product or acceptance.

mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: terminalHitExcess by positive overkill: only canonical overkill greater than zero creates the mark; exact lethal is null.
terminalHitExcess by aspect: only Dusk owns the intrinsic Facet entitlement; Ash is null.
terminalHitExcess by card topology: multiple eligible targets aggregate to the same one-request card cap.
terminalHitExcess by Ember cap: requested one is invariant while realised payoff may be zero.

aliasStructure.nullAliases: Current-main absence, class-default omission and explicit false/false are exact aliases.
aliasStructure.exactLethal: Canonical overkill zero is an explicit null and the closed exact-lethal family is not pooled or reopened.
aliasStructure.closedFamilies: Generic any-kill and Reaper consume at death; this consumer is the same card's later Facet settlement. Next-PLAY, target transfer, Shatter tempo, draw, duplicate, Scoreline and Afterimage remain closed and absent.
aliasStructure.nonScalar: Numeric overkill is verified in producer telemetry but cannot alter the one-unit payoff or become a threshold, bin or selected subset.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python owns the fixed matrix, two processes, content-addressed caching, exact comparisons and decision.
executionAndStopping.order: Verify immutable inputs and static cardinality; execute the complete current-main plan once; execute the complete candidate plan once; analyse the only look; verify byte-identical ledger.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: The 58 observations are the only look. No source, row, overkill value, comparator, threshold or cap changes after execution begins.
executionAndStopping.noRepair: Any completed null, exact-lethal exclusion, chain, cardinality, intended-mediator, RNG or ledger failure closes positive overkill without repair or rerun.

decisionRules.success: All immutable/static gates pass; all 58 rows complete; current-main/omitted/off identity, negative AB nulls, numeric overkill attribution, A/B/AB isolation, one-per-card cap, authored-chip/Beacon exclusion, cap realisation, final expiry, pending clear and RNG checks pass; ledger is byte-identical within 120 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply boundary 1: freeze only positive-overkill-facet-salvage-one-ember for a separately preregistered fresh existing-policy natural-capacity check. Add no policy control, magnitude level, endpoint row, protected seed, ML, RL or optimiser.
decisionRules.futility: Any completed source, interface, null, exact-lethal exclusion, A/B/AB, chain, cap, expiry, non-scalar, isolation, RNG, row-count or ledger gate fails.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply boundary 2: close positive overkill and the complete terminal-hit precision/excess class without repair; continue serially with zero-row cross-turn hold lifecycle design inside #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A frozen input/process is unavailable or the exact decision is unavailable at 120 seconds.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply boundary 3: record positive-overkill identity inconclusive at cap; do not rerun, alter the matrix or use protected seeds.

forbidden: any support, magnitude, capacity, endpoint, balance, product, acceptance or P9 claim
any overkill threshold, bin, scaling, card or target subset
any policy control, Scoreline, Afterimage, acquisition or Ward variation
any repair, rerun, reserve row, protected seed, ML, RL or optimiser
